_comment: Campaign key -> PARAPHE_* environment variable, read by the tests of BOTH
languages. The keys stay French: they name campagne.yaml entries and the
{placeholders} a campaign team edits by hand. The variables are English:
they are read by whoever operates the service.
The mapping cannot be derived by uppercasing the key any more, and the two
implementations (outils/config.ts, api/config.go) each hold their own copy.
Adding a field here obliges both to answer, exactly like gabarit-cases.json.
